entries.name: count-expected-unchecked
entries.claim: C1. A posted initial count or correction leaves on-hand at the counted quantity as of the count's instant: each line's expected must equal the ledger for its item at the count's location, read under the stock locks taken at BEGIN, or the posting is refused with INVENTORY_COUNT_EXPECTED_STALE and writes nothing.
entries.replacement: // control: the expected-is-ledger check is not called

kills.name: stock-count expected: a stale expected is refused and posts nothing, and a count names each item once
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: deleting the expected-is-ledger check must make this stale count post

entries.name: count-repeats-an-item
entries.claim: C1. An initial count or a correction names each item once, so no variance is posted twice against one ledger balance.
entries.original: throw inputError('a stock count names each item once');
entries.replacement: void 'a stock count names each item once';

kills.name: stock-count expected: a stale expected is refused and posts nothing, and a count names each item once
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: deleting the one-line-per-item rule must let one item be counted twice

entries.name: count-expected-current-balance
entries.claim: C2. Expected is read as of the count's effective instant: a movement effective at that instant counts before it, and one dated after it never makes the count stale.

test.namePattern: stock-count expected: a movement dated after

kills.name: stock-count expected: a movement dated after the count does not make it stale, and one at its instant counts before it
kills.expected: INVENTORY_COUNT_EXPECTED_STALE: stock-count line \S+ expects 0, but the ledger holds 4

entries.name: correction-location-unchecked
entries.claim: C3. A correction supersedes exactly one posted count at the same location, and posts what is counted less what the ledger holds as of the correction's instant.

test.namePattern: stock-count correction: a correction at another location

kills.name: stock-count correction: a correction at another location is refused, and one posted count takes one correction
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: deleting the same-location comparison must let a correction supersede a count of another location

entries.name: reviewed-count-still-updatable
entries.claim: C4. The posting kernel is the only writer of what a count posts: a reviewed count and its lines take no generic create, update, archive or restore (nor does a posted or cancelled one), the companion relations are in no generic input or form, and the stock documents List reads only adjustments and transfers.

test.namePattern: draft transaction and terminal stock-count evidence

kills.name: draft transaction and terminal stock-count evidence is enforced by the real gateway and PostgreSQL interpreter
kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: restoring the not-posted guard must let a reviewed count be sent back to counting generically

entries.name: count-companion-fence-removed
entries.claim: C5. A reviewed count that already names a companion transaction -- a shape no generic writer can now produce -- is refused by name before anything is written.
entries.original:
const expectedCompanionId =
    state === binding.stockCountReviewedState ? null : command.transactionId;

test.namePattern: a reviewed count that already names a companion transaction

kills.name: stock-count companion derivation: a reviewed count that already names a companion transaction is refused
kills.expected: the refusal must name the companion, not the reviewed evidence at large

entries.name: count-physical-quantity-overwritten
entries.claim: C6. A count's Post changes nothing on the count or its lines beyond its transition: a line's physical count, and the count's type and counting mode, which no posting writes, are proved identical to the bytes the evidence lock froze.

kills.name: stock-count posting preserves three-value evidence and appends correction and exact reversal through the shared protocol
kills.expected: INVENTORY_COUNT_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: stock-count line \S+ was altered in a column its posting transition does not write

entries.name: count-physical-quantity-last-decimal
entries.claim: C6. The read-back proves a line's physical count unchanged to its last decimal: a Post that moves 1.000000000000000001 to 1.000000000000000002 is refused, not compared as one JavaScript number.

test.namePattern: proved unchanged to its last decimal

kills.name: stock-count read-back: a physical count is proved unchanged to its last decimal
kills.expected: INVENTORY_COUNT_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: stock-count line \S+ was altered in a column its posting transition does not write
